build_fp32_params: build FP32 parameter copies from FP16 model parameters for mixed precision training
backward_loss_scaling: compute scaled gradients by multiplying loss with dynamic loss scale before backprop
clip_grad_norm: clip gradient norm and update dynamic loss scaler to detect overflow during training
step_optimizer: perform an optimization step by syncing FP16 grads to FP32 and updating model parameters
load_state_dict: load optimizer state dict including loss scale to resume training from a checkpoint
